blocks.label: Be immune to a type and heal when hit by it
blocks.summary: Moves of the Water type cannot hurt me; instead I heal 25% of my max HP (nothing if I am already at full HP). Example: Poison, 25 = like Poison Absorb.
blocks.whenLabel: While the game checks whether a move can hit me
examples: Immune to Poison moves and heal a quarter of my max HP when hit by one, like Poison Absorb
Immune to Water moves and heal 50% of my max HP

params.label: Immune to moves of this type
Heal this share of my max HP (% of max HP, 25 = a quarter)

feasibility: Moves that hit a whole side or the whole field (Spikes, Rain Dance) and my own moves are never blocked
Status moves of the chosen type are blocked too (unlike a plain type immunity)
The heal only happens when I am not at full HP; at full HP the move is still blocked but shows the usual no-effect message

blocks.label: Be immune to a type and raise my better attacking stat
blocks.summary: Moves of the Fire type cannot hurt me; instead my higher attacking stat (Attack or Sp. Atk) rises by 1 stage(s). Example: Fire, 1 = like Heat Sink.
blocks.whenLabel: While the game checks whether a move can hit me
examples: Immune to Fire moves and my higher attacking stat rises by 1 stage when one hits me, like Heat Sink
Immune to Ice moves and my best attack rises by 1 stage, like Ice Dew

params.label: Immune to moves of this type
Number of stages for my higher attacking stat (1 to 6 raises, -1 to -6 lowers, never 0)

feasibility: Moves that hit a whole side or the whole field (Spikes, Rain Dance) and my own moves are never blocked

The game compares my Attack and Sp. Atk without stat stages; on a tie Attack is chosen

blocks.label: Be immune to a type and change a stat when hit by it
blocks.summary: Moves of the Water type cannot hurt me; instead my Sp. Atk changes by 1 stage(s). Example: Flying, Speed, 1 = like Aerodynamics.
blocks.whenLabel: While the game checks whether a move can hit me
examples: Immune to Flying moves and my Speed rises by 1 stage when one hits me, like Aerodynamics
Immune to Grass moves and my Attack rises by 1 stage, like Sap Sipper
